baseline.scope: Final native address layout with public synthetic configuration; no stock overlay, no candidate firmware output, no device access

linked_stack.scope: Linked compiler frame metadata plus disassembled direct calls; tail calls added conservatively; no complete bound
limitations: ROM/assembly callees, interrupt nesting and stock caller frames are not modeled
Indirect calls, unrecognized branch forms and missing function/frame symbols can omit paths
Compiler metadata covers inlining but not runtime stack high-water
Sums are neither a general upper nor lower bound
Synthetic constants can alter final compiler/linker output; real fresh one-boot configuration needs independent audit
0x33c00 is historical packaging policy, not a measured current safe heap boundary
No runtime stack/IRQ/heap peak, fragmentation, DMA or firmware boot verified
No CRC-patched combined image emitted or deployed
Fitting address layout is not standalone readiness or stability
